zh.title: 新加坡航空奪Skytrax世界最佳航空 卡達航空失冠
zh.summary: 新加坡航空在Skytrax獎項超越卡達航空奪得世界最佳航空殊榮
body: 根據Simple Flying最新報導，新加坡航空在2026年Skytrax世界大航空獎最具聲望的「世界最佳航空」類別中成功超越卡達航空，重新奪得榮譽頭銜。
卡達航空因此失去連續多年保持的世界最佳航空地位，由新加坡航空取而代之，標誌著全球航空服務排名的重大變化。
Skytrax獎項被公認為航空業最具公信力的服務評比體系，此次結果反映乘客對航空公司服務體驗評價的最新趨向。
相關獎項於近期正式揭曉，完整得獎名單與評分詳情可參考Skytrax官方發布的正式公告資訊。

en.title: Singapore Airlines Overtakes Qatar Airways as Skytrax World's Best Airline
en.summary: Singapore Airlines overtakes Qatar Airways for Skytrax top honour; Qatar Airways loses world's best title
body: Simple Flying reported on September 18, 2026 that Singapore Airlines overtook Qatar Airways in the most prestigious category of the Skytrax World Airline Awards to reclaim the "World's Best Airline" title.
Qatar Airways consequently loses the world's best airline status it had held for consecutive years, marking a significant shift in global airline service rankings.
The Skytrax Awards are widely regarded as the aviation industry's most credible service benchmark, and the latest result reflects evolving passenger perceptions of airline service quality.
The awards were announced recently; the full list of winners and scoring details are available in Skytrax's official announcement.

zh.title: 北美洲台灣無人機協會與新樂飛簽MOU 拓銷非紅供應鏈無人機赴美
zh.summary: 北美洲台灣無人機協會與新樂飛簽MOU；台製非紅供應鏈無人機將外銷美國
body: 北美洲台灣無人機協會（NATUAVA）與新樂飛無人機公司2026年9月18日在嘉義縣亞創中心簽署備忘錄（MOU），由嘉義縣長翁章梁見證，雙方合作目標是將台灣產製的非紅供應鏈無人機銷售至美國市場，共創台美無人機產業新局。
北美洲台灣無人機協會會長陳世修表示，面對全球地緣政治變局與「去紅供應鏈」趨勢，台灣無人機產業正迎來重要戰略轉折點。他指出，美國政府單位為防範技術滲透與敏感資訊外洩，已要求導入非紅供應鏈，逐步汰換既有由中國供應商提供的無人機系統，這被視為台灣無人機進軍美國的良機。
翁章梁在見證簽約時說明，台灣在中、小型無人機製造實力雄厚，美國則在大型無人機佔優，目前國際社會提到非紅供應鏈無人機即想到台灣，各國正努力建立非紅供應鏈鏈結，無人機具未來性且將是台灣重要產業。
新樂飛無人機公司執行長許新勝強調，無人機已非單純飛行載具，而是整合AI運算、通訊加密、感測器與精密控制的「空中邊緣運算載台」。他指出，在政府協助下，台灣無人機產業在飛控、引擎等關鍵技術已成形且能自製，且台灣廠商客製化能力極強，對進軍美國市場充滿信心。
北美洲台灣無人機協會進一步指出，美國正積極推動「再工業化」與重建本土國防及商用無人機產能，但面臨在地供應鏈斷層與系統整合效率不足挑戰，此次結盟不僅是商業合作擴展，更屬「技術與產業對接」。

en.title: North America Taiwan UAV Association and Xinlefei Sign MOU to Export Taiwan-Made Non-Red Supply Chain Drones to US
en.summary: North America Taiwan UAV Association and Xinlefei sign MOU; Taiwan-made non-red supply chain drones for US export
body: The North America Taiwan UAV Association (NATUAVA) and Xinlefei UAV Company signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on September 18, 2026 at the Asia UAV AI Innovation Application R&D Center in Chiayi County, witnessed by Chiayi County Magistrate Weng Zhangliang. The partnership aims to sell Taiwan-manufactured non-red supply chain drones to the United States, creating a new chapter for Taiwan-US drone industry cooperation.

NATUAVA President Chen Shixiu stated that amid global geopolitical shifts and the "de-red supply chain" trend, Taiwan's drone industry faces a crucial strategic turning point. He noted that US government agencies, to prevent technology infiltration and sensitive information leakage, have required adoption of non-red supply chains and are gradually replacing existing drone systems supplied by Chinese vendors, which presents a prime opportunity for Taiwan drones to enter the US market.

Magistrate Weng Zhangliang remarked during the signing ceremony that Taiwan possesses strong capabilities in medium and small drone manufacturing, while the US excels in large drones. He observed that internationally, mention of non-red supply chain drones now brings Taiwan to mind, with countries actively establishing non-red supply chain linkages; drones have future potential and will become a key industry for Taiwan.

Xinlefei CEO Xu Xinsheng emphasized that drones are no longer mere flying vehicles but "airborne edge computing platforms" integrating AI computing, communication encryption, sensors, and precision control. He added that with government support, Taiwan's drone industry has matured in flight control, engine and other critical technologies, achieving self-production, and that Taiwanese manufacturers' strong customization capabilities give him high confidence in penetrating the US market.

NATUAVA further pointed out that the US is actively promoting "re-industrialization" and rebuilding domestic defense and commercial drone production capacity, but faces challenges of local supply chain gaps and insufficient system integration efficiency. This alliance is described not only as commercial cooperation expansion but also as "technology and industry docking."

zh.title: 馬航傳將下單首批波音787夢想客機
zh.summary: 馬航接近訂購首批波音787夢想客機；集團擬以10架787-10汰換租賃的7架A350
body: 根據彭博報導，馬來西亞航空接近下單其首批波音787夢想客機，以汰換目前租賃的七架空中巴士A350。報導稱，母公司馬來西亞航空集團正評估購買10架波音787-10。
報導指出，波音承諾自2031年起的較早交機時程，因而領先同為競標者的空中巴士。
馬來西亞航空集團總裁兼執行長Nasaruddin Bakar曾在8月向媒體表示，集團現有7架A350，將以至少7架替換，並可能超出此數以尋求成長。
報導亦提及，替換機型候選名單包括A350-1000、波音787-9、787-10及未來的777X。

en.title: Malaysia Airlines nears order for first Boeing 787 Dreamliners: Bloomberg
en.summary: Malaysia Airlines nears ordering Boeing 787-10s; parent group reportedly weighs 10 jets to replace leased A350s.
body: Malaysia Airlines is close to ordering its first Boeing 787 Dreamliners as it looks to replace seven leased Airbus A350s, according to Bloomberg.
On September 18, 2026, Bloomberg reported that the airline's parent company, Malaysia Aviation Group, was weighing an order for 10 Boeing 787-10s, the largest Dreamliner.
The report said Boeing got ahead of Airbus by promising earlier delivery slots beginning in 2031.
Group CEO Captain Nasaruddin Bakar told The Edge in August that while there are seven A350s today, the group is looking at growth as well, so there could be more than seven replacements.
Aircraft under consideration were noted as including the A350-1000, Boeing 787-9, 787-10, and the upcoming 777X.
